title: ACC004 Flight Simulator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > POD > W2SN ENDIST ALASKA
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers USACE, Alaska District, is seeking to identify a Design-Build Team or Design-Builder for ACC004 Flight Simulator a project in support of the Fighter Town Recapitalization FTR Program at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson JBER, Alaska. The FTR Program is a multiphase initiative to redevelop a significant portion of JBER with modern, resilient, and expanded infrastructure while maintaining mission continuity for active base and airfield operations throughout all phases of construction and facility turnover.
